tool.name: mash triangle
tool.command:
#import re #set $input_files = [] #for $input in $inputs #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-_\.]', '_', $input.element_identifier) + '.' + $input.ext ln -s '$input' '$safe_name' && #silent $input_files.append(str($safe_name)) #end for #set $file_list = ' '.join(["'%s'" % $f for $f in $input_files])
mash triangle -p \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -s $sketch_settings.sketch_size -k $sketch_settings.kmer_size -w $sketch_settings.prob_threshold #if str($sketch_settings.input_type.input_type_selector) == "reads": -r -m $sketch_settings.input_type.minimum_kmer_copies #if $sketch_settings.input_type.target_coverage: -c $sketch_settings.input_type.target_coverage #end if #if $sketch_settings.input_type.genome_size: -g $sketch_settings.input_type.genome_size #end if #elif str($sketch_settings.input_type.input_type_selector) == "assembly": $sketch_settings.input_type.individual_sequences #end if #if str($output_settings.out.format) == "edge_list": -E -v $output_settings.out.max_p_value -d $output_settings.out.max_distance #end if $file_list #if str($output_settings.out.format) == "phylip": #set $mt = str($output_settings.out.raw.matrix_type) #if $mt == "square" or $mt == "lower_triangle" or $mt == "upper_triangle": #if $output_settings.out.raw.relaxed: #set $relaxed_flag = "--relaxed" #else: #set $relaxed_flag = "" #end if #if $mt == "lower_triangle" or $mt == "upper_triangle": #if $output_settings.out.raw.include_diagonal: #set $diagonal_flag = "--diagonal" #else: #set $diagonal_flag = "" #end if #else: #set $diagonal_flag = "" #end if > raw_triangle.tmp && python '$convert_script' raw_triangle.tmp '$output' '$mt' $relaxed_flag $diagonal_flag #else: > '$output' #end if #else: > '$output' #end if

configfiles.configfile:
#import re import sys
name_map = { #for $input in $inputs #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-_\.]', '_', str($input.element_identifier)) + '.' + str($input.ext) "$safe_name": "$input.element_identifier", #end for }
input_file = sys.argv[1] output_file = sys.argv[2] mode = sys.argv[3] relaxed = '--relaxed' in sys.argv diagonal = '--diagonal' in sys.argv
with open(input_file) as f: lines = f.read().strip().split('\n')
n = int(lines[0].strip()) raw_names = [] matrix = [[0.0] * n for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n): parts = lines[i + 1].split('\t') raw_name = parts[0] raw_names.append(name_map.get(raw_name, raw_name)) for j in range(len(parts) - 1): val = float(parts[j + 1]) matrix[i][j] = val matrix[j][i] = val
if relaxed: max_len = max(len(nm) for nm in raw_names) pad = max(max_len, 10) names = [nm.ljust(pad) for nm in raw_names] else: names = [nm[:10].ljust(10) for nm in raw_names]
fmt = [['%.6f' % matrix[i][j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)] col_w = [max(len(fmt[i][j]) for i in range(n)) for j in range(n)]
with open(output_file, 'w') as f: f.write('%d\n' % n) for i in range(n): if mode == 'square': parts = [fmt[i][j].rjust(col_w[j]) for j in range(n)] elif mode == 'lower_triangle': end = i + 1 if diagonal else i parts = [fmt[i][j].rjust(col_w[j]) for j in range(end)] elif mode == 'upper_triangle': start = i if diagonal else i + 1 parts = [] for j in range(n): if j < start: parts.append(' ' * col_w[j]) else: parts.append(fmt[i][j].rjust(col_w[j]))
if not parts or all(p.isspace() for p in parts): f.write('%s\n' % names[i].rstrip()) elif relaxed: f.write('%s %s\n' % (names[i], ' '.join(parts))) else: f.write('%s%s\n' % (names[i], ' '.join(parts)))

param.name: inputs
param.label: Input sequences
param.help: A dataset collection of fasta, fastq (gzipped or not), or Mash sketch files (.msh) with matching k-mer sizes.

param.name: input_type_selector
param.label: Input type
param.help: Select 'Reads' for FASTQ input to enable the -r flag and reads-specific options. For pre-sketched .msh input, these settings are ignored.

param.name: individual_sequences
param.label: Sketch individual sequences
param.help: Sketch individual sequences rather than whole files, e.g. for multi-FASTAs of single-chromosome genomes or pairwise gene comparisons.

param.name: minimum_kmer_copies
param.label: Minimum copies of each k-mer required to pass noise filter

param.name: target_coverage
param.label: Target coverage
param.help: If specified, sketching will conclude if this coverage is reached before the end of the input file (estimated by average k-mer multiplicity).

param.name: genome_size
param.label: Genome size
param.help: If specified, will be used for p-value calculation instead of an estimated size from k-mer content.

param.name: sketch_size
param.label: Sketch size
param.help: Each sketch will have at most this many non-redundant min-hashes.

param.name: prob_threshold
param.label: Probability threshold for warning about low k-mer size

param.name: format
param.label: Specify the output format
param.help: PHYLIP format is compatible with many downstream phylogenetic tools. For edge list, output fields will be [seq1, seq2, dist, p-val, shared-hashes].

param.name: matrix_type
param.label: Matrix type
param.help: Square is compatible with most tools. Lower/upper triangle are more compact. Raw output is unmodified Mash output.

param.name: relaxed
param.label: Relaxed PHYLIP format
param.help: When enabled, taxon names are not truncated to 10 characters. Disable for strict PHYLIP compatibility.

tool.help:
**Mash triangle** estimates the distance of each input sequence to every other input sequence and outputs a distance matrix.
**Sketching options:**
When providing raw sequence files (FASTA/FASTQ) rather than pre-made Mash sketch files (.msh), the following sketch parameters can be configured:
- **Input type**: Select whether your input files are assemblies (FASTA) or reads (FASTQ). This determines which sketch options are available. For pre-sketched .msh input, these settings are ignored. - **Sketch size** (-s): Number of non-redundant min-hashes per sketch (default: 1000). - **K-mer size** (-k): Length of k-mers used for hashing (default: 21, max: 32). - **Probability threshold** (-w): Threshold for warning about low k-mer size (default: 0.01). - **Individual sequences** (-i, assembly only): Sketch each sequence separately rather than the whole file. - **Minimum k-mer copies** (-m, reads only): Minimum observations of a k-mer to pass the noise filter (default: 1). - **Target coverage** (-c, reads only): Stop sketching when this coverage is reached. - **Genome size** (-g, reads only): Use this genome size for p-value calculation instead of estimating from k-mer content.
**Output formats:**
- **PHYLIP distance matrix** (default): A distance matrix in PHYLIP format. Sub-options:
- *Matrix type*: Square (full symmetric, default), lower triangle, upper triangle, or raw output (unmodified Mash output). - *Relaxed*: When enabled, taxon names are not truncated to 10 characters. Strict PHYLIP limits names to 10 characters.
Taxon names are derived from dataset collection element identifiers.
- **Edge list**: A tabular list of pairwise distances with fields [seq1, seq2, distance, p-value, shared-hashes].
